datasets.name: Chieti Affective Action Video (CAAV)
datasets.decision: Included: official item metadata gives a clear CC0 licence.

datasets.name: DEVO-2
datasets.mediaRights: No verified blanket redistribution licence for every stimulus
datasets.decision: Not mirrored until every clip's source-level redistribution permission is documented.

datasets.name: Affective Video Database Online Study (AVDOS)
datasets.mediaRights: Figshare item is CC BY 4.0; underlying third-party clip rights remain unresolved
datasets.decision: Not mirrored because the stimuli were sourced from services including YouTube, Twitch, and Reddit and need a clip-level rights audit.

datasets.name: LIRIS-ACCEDE
datasets.mediaRights: Signed EULA and institutional access required; original film licences vary
datasets.decision: Not mirrored. Acquire through the official EULA flow and audit the licence of each selected film or clip.

datasets.name: One-Minute Silent Videos
datasets.mediaRights: Ratings are public; exact videos are linked or supplied by the authors without a verified blanket media licence
datasets.decision: Not mirrored until the selected source videos have documented redistribution permission.

datasets.name: Expanded Emotional Movie Database
datasets.decision: Not mirrored because access and redistribution are controlled by agreement.

datasets.name: Emo-FilM
datasets.mediaRights: Film-level Creative Commons conditions must be preserved
datasets.decision: Priority candidate for a coherent ten-minute benchmark because LIRIS supplies continuous induced valence/arousal. Not mirrored until official EULA access and film-level licence/cut review are complete.

datasets.name: Open Library for Affective Videos
datasets.decision: All original aggregate/raw rating CSVs and codebooks are mirrored. The 188 videos remain upstream because the Pages site has insufficient capacity for another full media corpus.

datasets.name: Database for Emotional Analysis of Music
datasets.mediaRights: Release and song-level Creative Commons/non-commercial conditions require preservation
datasets.decision: Best public continuous valence/arousal audio benchmark, but ratings concern emotion perceived in music rather than necessarily induced listener affect.

datasets.name: International Database of Emotional Short Texts
datasets.mediaRights: Article permits academic research; verify an explicit derivative/redistribution licence before publishing audio
datasets.decision: Best vignette candidate. Any narration or text-to-speech output is a new audio stimulus and requires fresh induced-affect validation.

datasets.name: Continuously Annotated Signals of Emotion
datasets.mediaRights: Several stimuli are commercial film or web excerpts
datasets.decision: Strongest procedural analogue for simultaneous continuous induced V/A, but not suitable for public media mirroring.

datasets.name: AMIGOS
datasets.mediaRights: Controlled research access and commercial film excerpts
datasets.decision: Long-form comparison corpus, but longer than the target and unsuitable for a public stimulus mirror.

datasets.name: Emo-Soundscapes
datasets.decision: Excellent six-second perceived-V/A audio coverage, but a ten-minute montage would be a new high-switching compound stimulus.

datasets.name: Stanford Emotional Narratives Dataset v1
datasets.mediaRights: Repository terms and participant media controls apply
datasets.decision: Narratives have continuous observer valence but no arousal; they do not provide two-dimensional induced-affect ground truth.

datasets.name: K-EmoCon
datasets.decision: Ten-minute debates are social-interaction recordings, not standardized emotion-inducing stimuli.
